summary: The EIC Pathfinder Challenges 2025 under Horizon Europe supports early-stage, high-risk/high-reward deep tech research projects with breakthrough innovation potential in four strategic areas: biotech for climate resilient crops and plant-based bio-manufacturing; generative AI agents for complex applications; next-generation health technologies; and deep-tech solutions for clean energy and sustainable environments. Grants up to €4 million are available to support projects aiming to create new markets and radically change industries or societal solutions.
activity_types: Early-stage research up to Technology Readiness Level (TRL) 4
reporting_requirements: Projects must present a long-term vision for breakthrough innovation
Regulatory awareness and ecological soundness for biotech projects
Continuation measures expected post-Pathfinder including intellectual property generation
